assumptions: WARP-0725 is a STANDALONE enforcement spec (lane: standalone, depends_on: []), so this commit adds it to no plan's work list and moves no plan file.

WHAT --repo-root MEANS IS NARROWED ON PURPOSE, and it is the only behavioural change outside the refusal: the directory a caller names chooses which artifacts are OFFERED, never which are entitled, and the paths it reports are now repository-relative (`--full-name`), so a verdict offered from a subdirectory is named in full on the stage line. Reconciling one repository's artifacts into another repository's log was already refused; it is now refused by membership rather than by a path relation, and it exits non-zero instead of 0.

THE REFUSAL EXITS NON-ZERO AND THE GATE'S STAGE GUARDS THE CALL WITH `||` AND TOUCHES NO FAIL, so it is reported there and still cannot redden a build over bookkeeping. The fallback text that `||` prints says `reconciliation unavailable`, which would be the wrong words for a refusal; scripts/verify.sh and its eight copies are outside this item's declared footprint, so the wording is left alone and declared here.

THE ENUMERATION IS WHAT GIT REPORTS, NOT WHAT A FILESYSTEM HOLDS. A process environment that redirects git's answers (GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE) makes another repository's enumeration the domain. That is declared as a limit in the module, not defended against, and it needs the same control that already permits appending to the log directly.

A TRACKED VERDICT ARTIFACT ANYWHERE UNDER THE DECLARED PROOF ROOT IS IN THE DOMAIN, because git's pathspec `*` crosses `/` (measured: a file committed at proof/deep/WARP-9999/verdict.json is returned by `git ls-files 'proof/*/verdict*.json'`). Both sides of the membership test use the one pathspec, so that is consistent rather than a gap: committing a verdict artifact under the proof root IS this repository's review record, and who may write one is the review discipline's question, not this predicate's.

THE `.warp/capabilities.yaml` NOTE IN ALL EIGHT COPIES STILL DESCRIBES THE REMOVED COMPARISON. Its other measured claim (the environment redirection) stays true. That file is outside this item's declared footprint and the shape gate refuses a change to a path a spec did not declare, so the stale clause is declared here as a residual rather than smuggled in.
rollback: git revert the fix commit. The behavioural change is one predicate: log_entitlement, which now takes only the log and returns the enumeration the repository that log belongs to produces; the pathspec parameter and `--full-name` on the two enumeration calls; the `unentitled` report field replacing `origin`; the non-zero exit on a refusal; and the deletion of repo_toplevel, re-synced byte-identical across plugin/templates and the six pack copies. Nothing persists: no migration, no state, no schema change. NOTE WHAT A REVERT CANNOT DO: any forged line already appended to a log cannot be rolled back by anything, in this repository or an adopter's, which is the reason this item exists - so a revert restores a projection that will import a forged pass out of any folder in the work tree and should be paired with re-queueing this item.
